This page manages Intent candidates for sharing, multi-file sharing, opening, browsers, deep links, and text processing. You can hide or keep components by rule, or change a component\'s display name in the system chooser. It does not modify the actual Intent, package name, component name, disable apps, or uninstall apps.
Current mode: Hide selected. Once the rules are active, selected components are hidden from the corresponding candidate lists; deselect them to restore the default display.
Current mode: Show selected only. Once the rules are active, selected components remain in the corresponding category and other components are hidden.
Current mode: Show all. System candidate-list cleaning is paused. Selections are saved but take effect after cleaning is resumed.

Use Apps to show All, User apps, or System apps; this only narrows the current view and bulk-action target set. Swipe right on an app or child item to lock it and swipe left to unlock it. Unlocked rows show no lock icon; a status icon appears only after locking. Full locks protect the whole app, while partial locks protect selected child entries. Locked entries skip Select All/Invert-style operations but remain manually editable. Locks do not participate in ordering or change selected/partial/unselected state, and Locked under All aggregates locks from the individual categories.

Editing dedicated rules for “Open · %1$s”. Effective selections combine the generic OPEN rules from All with rules dedicated to the current type. Inherited items remain selected and show their source when expanded. Inherited items must be deselected under All; rules added for the current type affect only that MIME, scheme, or file-extension type.
